provider: Higgsfield connector / Mirelo Text to Audio (mirelo_text_to_audio)
storage: Cloud-generated, downloaded directly to external T7 Shield.
purpose: Two short interface sounds: the moment a microscope picture turns sharp, and the moment a restored lab lights up.
review: Not heard by a person. Checked with earshot (CLAP/AST tags and meters): focus reads as a short click (scroll wheel tick z +2.8, mouse click z +2.4); sparkle reads as chimes (AudioSet Chime 0.60, magic sparkle chime z +3.1). Two takes that did not match their brief (a stamp and a marimba jingle) were discarded and are not shipped.

jobs.prompt: A short crisp focus confirmation sound: one soft mechanical lens click followed by a tiny bright glassy chime, clean and gentle, no music, no voice
jobs.processing: ffmpeg: 0.285–0.455 s, 4 ms fade in, 60 ms fade out, +32.5 dB, mono 44.1 kHz PCM 16-bit

jobs.prompt: Level complete success jingle, glockenspiel and marimba ascending melody, cheerful, bright, short video game win sound
jobs.note: The take came out as chimes rather than a melody, so it is used as a sparkle, not as a fanfare.
jobs.processing: ffmpeg: 0.15–1.20 s, 4 ms fade in, 270 ms fade out, +11.5 dB, mono 44.1 kHz PCM 16-bit
